Audience: first-time Missouri Class F applicants, from teens on an instruction permit to adult newcomers, who will need insurance before they register or drive a vehicle.
Why it matters to a first-timer: the coverage minimums are exact dollar values [A01], the lapse suspension ladder pairs look-alike fees and periods [A02], and the crash steps and the Move It law are classic scenario items [A03].
Level: dollar-amount recall plus an ordered crash procedure; moderate load.
Prerequisites: the titling and registration chapter, since proof of insurance is required to register or renew.
